name: Austil de Mon
summary: In Brill, Austil de Mon trains Forsaken warriors at Gallows' End Tavern. He teaches the newly risen to fight in service of the Dark Lady.

sections.title: A Veteran in Gallows' End
sections.body: Austil de Mon trains Forsaken warriors inside Gallows' End Tavern in Brill. Warriors leaving Deathknell come to him among their first instructors. The living once drank and rested in the inn. Now Austil teaches newly liberated undead to master martial discipline and combat against the foes surrounding the kingdom.

faq.answer: Austil de Mon trains undead warriors in Brill, Tirisfal Glades, teaching Forsaken fighters.

faq.q: Where can I find Austil de Mon?
faq.answer: You can find Austil de Mon in Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, Tirisfal Glades, just north of the Undercity.

faq.q: What role does he play in Brill?
faq.answer: Austil teaches novice warriors fighting techniques, stances, and martial abilities, strengthening the Forsaken military against local threats.

angles.text: As a Forsaken warrior leaving Deathknell, you can seek Austil de Mon as a mentor for guidance and formal ability training in Tirisfal Glades.
As newly risen undead, you can train with Austil to become a frontline fighter ready to defend Lordaeron against the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade.
